name: Central Distribution Centre
description: A regional warehouse receiving, storing and dispatching consumer products.
operationalRules: All incoming shipments require document verification.
Damaged goods cannot enter available inventory.
Unverified goods must remain on hold.

departmentDefinitions.name: Receiving Department
departmentDefinitions.description: Handles incoming goods and supplier deliveries.
departmentDefinitions.shiftPattern: Two shifts per day (06:00-14:00, 14:00-22:00), one Receiving Supervisor and 2-4 Warehouse Associates per shift depending on scheduled deliveries.
departmentDefinitions.escalationPath: Warehouse Associate -> Receiving Supervisor -> Warehouse Manager. Associates escalate any exception they cannot resolve against SOP-RCV-001 without waiting for supervisor approval to quarantine or hold stock.
keyPerformanceIndicators: Dock-to-stock time (minutes from truck arrival to receiving decision)
Discrepancy detection rate (documented discrepancies / actual discrepancies present)
Non-compliant stock leakage (compliant-marked items later found damaged or wrong-SKU in inventory)

departmentDefinitions.name: Put Away Department
departmentDefinitions.description: Moves accepted stock from Receiving into the correct storage zones.

workstationDefinitions.name: Receiving Dock
workstationDefinitions.description: Roll-up dock door 3, one bay. A pallet truck and a wrapped delivery wait just inside; the driver is parked at the yellow line until the shipment is confirmed against paperwork.

workstationDefinitions.name: Document Desk
workstationDefinitions.description: A single desk just inside the dock office, purchase orders and delivery notes filed by supplier. This is where every shipment starts — nothing moves to the dock until the paperwork has been compared.

workstationDefinitions.name: Inspection Zone
workstationDefinitions.description: A stainless steel table under bright task lighting, positioned so cartons come straight off the dock trolley. Damage tags, a tape measure and a digital scale sit within reach; nothing inspected here re-enters the flow without a recorded finding.

workstationDefinitions.name: Barcode Station
workstationDefinitions.description: A fixed-mount scanner and a small screen bolted beside the inspection table. Every carton passes under the scanner exactly once before it can move on.

workstationDefinitions.name: Quarantine Zone
workstationDefinitions.description: A caged, clearly marked holding area beside the dock, separated from the general aisle by a painted red line. Nothing in this cage counts as available stock until a disposition is confirmed and logged.

workstationDefinitions.name: Receiving Office
workstationDefinitions.description: A small glass-walled office overlooking the dock. This is where the shift's paper trail becomes a decision — the discrepancy report, the accept/reject call, and the note to the supervisor all happen at this one desk.

workstationDefinitions.name: Staging Area
workstationDefinitions.description: Accepted stock from Receiving waits here for a storage assignment.

workstationDefinitions.name: Location Planning
workstationDefinitions.description: Assign every item to its correct storage zone.

workstationDefinitions.name: Transport and Placement
workstationDefinitions.description: Move and place every item, then scan to confirm.

workstationDefinitions.name: Putaway Office
workstationDefinitions.description: Complete the putaway report and notify the supervisor.
